description: This file is part of the SuiteCRM installation process, specifically handling the license acceptance page. It outputs an HTML page containing license text and user interaction elements for agreeing to the license terms.

methods.name: toggleNextButton
methods.description: Enables or disables the 'Next' button based on the license acceptance checkbox.

methods.name: toggleLicenseAccept
methods.description: Toggles the license acceptance checkbox state.

methods.name: callSysCheck
methods.description: Initiates a system check via AJAX before proceeding to the next setup step.

methods.name: countdown
methods.description: Performs a countdown timer before redirecting, used during system check success.
